info.title: Assay
info.description: Code analysis CLI for AI agents — builds a queryable graph from C# solutions.

commands.name: kitchensink
commands.description:
Run all analyses and prioritize findings (alias: all, triage)
mcp       [solution]                              Run MCP server (stdio) for agent integrations

options.name: --top
options.description: Top N findings per category (default: 5)

options.name: --severity
options.description: Minimum severity to include (critical, high, medium, low) (default: low)

options.name: --skip
options.description: Skip a category (repeatable): vulnerability, license, crap, coveragegap, diagnostic, churn

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 2 if any finding is at or above this severity

options.name: --output
options.description: Write a markdown+HTML report bundle to a directory

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Exclude paths matching a glob (repeatable)

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Include code-generated members (excluded by default)

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Use an existing coverage report (file or glob), or 'auto' to collect

options.name: --no-coverage
options.description: Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery (output shows n/a)

options.name: --json
options.description: Output as JSON instead of structured markdown

options.name: --lightweight
options.description: Use structural-only analysis (fast, no Roslyn)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Force re-analysis, bypassing the graph cache

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show progress and diagnostic output on stderr

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help and exit

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to a .sln/.slnx file (auto-detected if omitted)

options.name: --detail
options.description: Detail level: full, interface, summary (type detail)

options.name: --kind
options.description: Filter search by vertex kind (type, namespace, assembly, project, file, member)

options.name: --parameter-type
options.description: Filter members by a parameter type. Substring or '*'-wildcard regex, case-sensitive. Forces --kind member.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum results (search: default 15)

options.name: --top
options.description: Top N results (health, churn, tests gaps: default 20)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum traversal depth (impact: default 3)

options.name: --change
options.description: Change kind: interface, signature, behavior, removal (impact: default signature)

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum token budget (type context: default 8000)

options.name: --max-types
options.description: Maximum types shown (assembly: default 100)

options.name: --max-length
options.description: Maximum path length (path: default 5)

options.name: --nested
options.description: Include nested namespaces (namespace)

options.name: --scope
options.description: Scope to a project (churn, trait)

options.name: --days
options.description: Lookback period in days (churn, volatility: default 90)

options.name: --min-coverage
options.description: Coverage-fraction threshold for churn --risk (default 0.5; replaces the deprecated churn --coverage)

options.name: --threshold
options.description: CRAP score threshold (crap, volatility: default 30)

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sort key for volatility: crap, volatility, combined (default combined)

options.name: --severity
options.description: Filter by severity (project diagnostics: default error; kitchensink: default low)

options.name: --skip
options.description: Skip a triage category (kitchensink; repeatable): vulnerability, license, crap, coveragegap, diagnostic, churn

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 2 if any kitchensink finding is at or above this severity (critical, high, medium, low)

options.name: --output
options.description: Write a markdown+HTML report bundle to a directory (kitchensink writes a multi-page bundle; single commands write a one-page bundle)

options.name: --force
options.description: Force assembly analysis for packages with unknown licenses

options.name: --allow-vendor
options.description: Allow packages by vendor prefix (repeatable)

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Exclude paths matching glob (search, tests gaps, overview, health; repeatable)

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Use an existing coverage report (file or glob). On crap/volatility/kitchensink/tests gaps/type, 'auto' collects coverage. On overview, coverage is used if available but 'dotnet test' is never run.

options.name: --no-coverage
options.description:
Skip coverage entirely: no collection, no report discovery; coverage-dependent output shows n/a (overview, health, crap, volatility, kitchensink, tests gaps, type)
--include-generated Include code-generated members in analysis (BuildRenderTree, [GeneratedCode], *.g.cs — excluded by default)

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include test-project types in analysis (crap, tests gaps — excluded by default)

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description:
Exclude test-project types from search results (search — included by default)
Exit codes:
0   Success
2   Findings threshold exceeded (kitchensink --fail-on)
64  Usage error (unknown option, bad value, or missing argument)
66  Solution or entity not found
70  Internal error

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the running binary's version and path
